references.text: Here a servant is mentioned whom God has chosen, and upon whom His Spirit will rest, which mirrors the event in Matthew 3:16 where the Holy Spirit comes upon Jesus.
This verse describes God's choice and love for His Son, a theme reflected in the baptism of Jesus, where God confirms Jesus as His beloved Son.
The Spirit hovers over the waters at creation, which can be seen as a parallel to the Holy Spirit coming upon Jesus at his baptism.
Peter refers to how God anointed Jesus with the Holy Spirit and power, which aligns with the event in Matthew 3:16.
This verse speaks of how God anointed Jesus with joy, which can be seen in connection with the baptism and the coming of the Holy Spirit upon him.
